'''Jasmin Staiblin''' (born 1 March 1970) is a German executive. She was the [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] of the [[Switzerland|Swiss]] energy group [[Alpiq]] 2013-2018. She was also the CEO of [[ABB | ABB Switzerland]] from 2006 to 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.munzinger.de/search/portrait/Jasmin+Staiblin/0/29752.html |title=Jasmin Staiblin |publisher=Munzinger |access-date=10 December 2017}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Jasmin Staiblin, daughter of Gerdi Stabilin, who was the former vice-president of the German Rural Woman's Association<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.munzinger.de/search/portrait/Gerdi+Staiblin/0/21850.html |title=Gerdi Staiblin |date=26 November 2001 |publisher=munzinger.de |access-date=14 November 2022}}</ref> and Minister for Food and Rural Affairs in the [[Baden-Württemberg]] state government, grew up on a winery in [[Endingen am Kaiserstuhl|Königschaffhausen]] am [[Kaiserstuhl (Baden-Württemberg)|Kaiserstuhl]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.badische-zeitung.de/aargau/suedbadenerin-wird-alpiq-boss--60167593.html |title=Südbadenerin wird Alpiq-Boss |date=1 June 2012 |publisher=Badische Zeitung |access-date=10 December 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bilanz.ch/unternehmen/energiewirtschaft-zwei-damen-unter-strom |title=Energiewirtschaft: Zwei Damen unter Strom |author=Ueli Kneubühler |date=8 January 2013 |publisher=Bilanz Ringier Axel Springer Schweiz |access-date=10 December 2017}}</ref> Her father Helmut Staiblin was cellarmaster of the local winegrowers' cooperative in [[Endingen am Kaiserstuhl|Königschaffhausen]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.focus.de/politik/deutschland/getraenke-das-deutsche-rotwein-wunder_aid_167533.html |title=Getränke: Das deutsche Rotwein-Wunder |author=Uli Martin |date=13 November 2013 |publisher=Focus |access-date=11 November 2020 |archive-date=19 March 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200319191515/https://www.focus.de/politik/deutschland/getraenke-das-deutsche-rotwein-wunder_aid_167533.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> During her childhood she saw her parents taking part in the resistance against the construction of the [[nuclear power]] plant in the neighboring village of [[Wyhl]] in 1975.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.handelszeitung.ch/panorama/die-milliardenwette-von-alpiq-chefin-jasmin-staiblin |title=Die Milliardenwette von Alpiq-Chefin Jasmin Staiblin |author=Philipp Albrecht, Florence Vuichard |date=29 May 2018 |publisher=Handelszeitung |access-date=11 November 2020}}</ref> Staiblin attended the Technical High School at the Gewerbliche und Hauswirtschaftlich-Sozialpflegerische Schulen in Emmendingen (GHSE). She studied electrical engineering and physics at the [[Karlsruhe Institute of Technology|Technical University in Karlsruhe]] and the [[Royal Institute of Technology|Royal Technical College in Stockholm]]. Her diploma thesis completed at [[KTH Royal Institute of Technology|KTH]] was awarded the "European University Award".<ref>{{cite book |last1=Mielke |first1=Christine |last2=Baur |first2=Christine |title=Deutschland? Aber wo liegt es? |year=2001 |location=Karlsruhe |publisher=Interfakultatives Institut für angewandte Kulturwissenschaft, Universität Karlsruhe |page=99–103, 165 |isbn=3980559580 |oclc=55652976 }}</ref>

== Career ==
From 1997, she worked as a research assistant at the [[ABB Group|ABB]] Research Center Dättwil and in 1999, became Sales Manager at ABB Hochspannungstechnik in [[Oerlikon (Zürich)|Oerlikon]]. After taking over the portfolio management and business development for the medium-voltage products division of the ABB Group in [[Zürich]] in 2000, she became a member of the management of the global ABB electrical engineering division in 2004, and in 2006, she became the country's chief executive of ABB [[Baden, Switzerland|Switzerland in Baden]] AG.<ref name="A">{{cite web |url=http://www.alpiq.com/de/images/cv-jasmin-staibllin_de_tcm96-95008.pdf |title=Curriculum Vitae Jasmin Staiblin |publisher=Alpiq |access-date=10 December 2017}}</ref> She held the post until 2012.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.handelszeitung.ch/panorama/die-milliardenwette-von-alpiq-chefin-jasmin-staiblin  |title=Die Milliardenwette von Alpiq-Chefin Jasmin Staiblin |author=Philipp Albrecht, Florence Vuichard |date=29 May 2018 |publisher=handelszeitung.ch |access-date=14 November 2022}}</ref>

In 2009, Staiblin, as CEO of ABB, took 16 weeks of [[Maternity leave in the United States|maternity leave]], causing controversy in Switzerland. In addition to the tabloid [[Blick]], the editor of [[Die Weltwoche]], [[Roger Köppel]], complained, that no man in a comparable position could afford to leave his job for personal reasons.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.emma.de/artikel/schweiz-wenn-maenner-durchdrehen-264100 |title=Schweiz: Wenn Männer durchdrehen |author=Alice Schwarzer |date=1 September 2009 |publisher=Emma |access-date=10 December 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.srf.ch/play/radio/popupaudioplayer?id=53bb51b9-ec44-4836-a909-2ae0076ab0b7&starttime=24.001 |title=Die neue Alpiq-Chefin ist schwanger |author=Roman Portmann |date=19 February 2013 |publisher=SRF Schweizer Radio und Fernsehen |access-date=10 December 2017}}</ref> Shortly after she joined Alpiq as CEO, it became known that Staiblin was expecting her second child.<ref name="C" /><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.emma.de/artikel/schweiz-wenn-maenner-durchdrehen-264100 |title=Schweiz: Wenn Männer durchdrehen |author=Alice Schwarzer |date=1 September 2009 |publisher=EMMA |access-date=25 November 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.srf.ch/news/regional/aargau-solothurn/neue-alpiq-chefin-jasmin-staiblin-ist-schwanger |title=Neue Alpiq-Chefin Jasmin Staiblin ist schwanger |date=19 February 2013 |publisher=SRF |access-date=25 November 2020}}</ref>

In 2012, the Board of Directors of Alpiq Holding AG appointed her as CEO of Alpiq effective as of 1 January 2013.<ref name="C">{{cite web |url=http://www.weltwoche.ch/ausgaben/2009-27/artikel-2009-27-editorial-die-ch.html |title=Die Chefin |author=Roger Köppel |publisher=Die Weltwoche |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130926144226/http://www.weltwoche.ch/ausgaben/2009-27/artikel-2009-27-editorial-die-ch.html |archive-date=26 September 2013 |access-date=19 November 2020}}</ref> She resigned at the end of 2018.<ref>{{cite web|title=Jasmin Staiblin verlässt Alpiq|periodical=[[Neue Zürcher Zeitung|nzz.ch]]|publisher=|url=https://www.nzz.ch/wirtschaft/jasmin-staiblin-verlaesst-alpiq-ld.1443006|url-status=|format=|access-date=2018-12-09|archive-url=|archive-date=|last=Giorgio V. Müller|date=2018-12-07|language=|pages=|quote=}}</ref> Her contract ran for another 12 months, for which she was released. For that year, she received total compensation of CHF 1.9 million.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tagesanzeiger.ch/millionen-fuer-ex-alpiq-chefin-obwohl-sie-nicht-mehr-arbeitete-783657402790  |title=Millionen für Ex-Alpiq-Chefin – obwohl sie nicht mehr arbeitete |author=Phillip Felber-Eisele |date=2 March 2020 |publisher=tagesanzeiger.ch |access-date=14 November 2022}}</ref>

From 2012 to 2021 Staiblin was a member of the Board of Directors of [[Rolls-Royce plc]]. On 11 June 2021, she was appointed Chairwoman of the Supervisory Board of [[Rolls-Royce Power Systems|Rolls-Royce Power Systems AG]] and [[MTU Friedrichshafen GmbH]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.foundry-planet.com/d/jasmin-staiblin-to-become-new-chairwoman-of-the-supervisory-board-of-rolls-royce-power-systems-ag-and-mtu-friedrichshafen-gmbh/ |title=Jasmin Staiblin to become new Chairwoman of the Supervisory Board of Rolls-Royce Power Systems AG and MTU Friedrichshafen GmbH |date=21 June 2021 |publisher=foundry-planet.com |access-date=14 March 2023}}</ref>

In 2016 Staiblin, CEO of Alpiq, was forced to justify the drastic reduction of its hydropower portfolio with the non-competitive production costs of [[hydropower]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.srf.ch/news/wirtschaft/herber-verlust-alpiq-verkauft-halbes-wasserkraftwerk-portfolio |title=Herber Verlust: Alpiq verkauft halbes Wasserkraftwerk-Portfolio |date=7 March 2016 |publisher=srf.ch |access-date=14 March 2023}}</ref> and would not exclude the possible sale of hydropower plants to a Chinese state-owned company.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.srf.ch/news/wirtschaft/alpiq-ceo-staiblin-verkauf-an-chinesen-nicht-ausgeschlossen |title=Alpiq-CEO Staiblin: Verkauf an Chinesen nicht ausgeschlossen |date=22 April 2016 |publisher=srf.ch |access-date=14 March 2023}}</ref>

== Memberships ==
* 2007: Member of the board of directors of Neue Aargauer Bank
* 2007: Vice president of Energie Trialog Schweiz
* 2008-2013: Member of the executive committee of [[Swissmem]]
* 2008-2012; 2014-2018: Board member of [[Economiesuisse]]
* 2011-2023: Member of the board of directors of [[Georg Fischer (Swiss company)]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.handelszeitung.ch/unternehmen/prominente-abgange-beim-industriekonzern-jasmin-staiblin-und-riet-cadonau-verlassen-den-verwaltungsrat-von-georg-fischer-547447 |title=Monica de Virgiliis stösst zum Georg-Fischer-Verwaltungsrat |date=17 November 2022 |publisher=handelszeitung.ch |access-date=24 October 2023}}</ref>
* 2012: Member of the board of directors of [[Rolls-Royce Holdings]]
* 2012: Board member of [[ETH Zurich]]
* 2012-2017: Vice President Swisselectric<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.tagblatt.ch/wirtschaft/wenn-manager-fremdgehen-die-sehr-gut-bezahlten-nebenjobs-der-firmenchefs-ld.1545422  |title=Wenn Manager fremdgehen: Die sehr gut bezahlten Nebenjobs der Firmenchefs |author=Andreas Schaffner |date=29 March 2016 |publisher=tagblatt.ch |access-date=14 November 2022}}</ref>
* 2012-2016: Director of [[ETH Board]]
* 2015: Independent Non-Executive Director of [[Rolls-Royce Holdings]]
* 2019: Independent Non-Executive Director of [[NXP Semiconductors]] N.V.
* 2019: Director of [[Zurich Insurance Group]] Ltd.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.marketscreener.com/business-leaders/Jasmin-Staiblin-06L8LN-E/biography/ |title=Business Leaders |publisher=Market Screener|access-date=25 November 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://theorg.com/org/zurich-insurance/team/jasmin-staiblin |title=Jasmin Staiblin Director at Zurich Insurance |publisher=The Org |access-date=25 November 2020 }}{{Dead link|date=October 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>
* 2020: Board member of [[Zap Energy]]
